title: Backend & APIs
description: Go and Python services, RESTful APIs and the databases behind them, structured with SOLID principles so they stay easy to change.

title: Algorithms
description: Logic where the numbers have to be right: loan amortization and repayment schedules, and feed formulation for livestock.

title: Data & machine learning
description: Models that solve practical problems, like identifying maize, cotton and tomato diseases from images with TensorFlow.

title: Embedded & IoT
description: Arduino and C++ systems that read sensors and respond in real time, built as clear state machines.

title: Full-stack products
description: Angular and React interfaces, prototyped in PenPot and built as components, so the whole product fits together.
